text: SYNTHETIC NOTICE. NASA hereby gives notice of its intent to grant an exclusive patent license in United States to practice the invention described and claimed in NASA Case No. LAR-17485-1 to Granite Peak Robotics, LLC, having its principal place of business at 17 Summit Road, Boulder, CO 80302. The fields of use may be limited to polymers and composites. NASA must receive written objections no later than August 18, 2026.
